# ELSE IF

Start the next conditional branch of a DO IF block.

## Syntax

```text
ELSE IF (condition).
```

## Example

```text
ELSE IF (age < 65).
```

`statscraft help ELSE IF` prints the same text in the terminal. [All commands](README.md)
